editorial.why_here: Founded in 2019, OMAKAI makes an authentic omakase experience accessible, built on Omotenashi hospitality from the heart, and its newest location in Doral delivers curated nigiri and hand rolls in an intimate room where guests trust the chef and leave it up to us through seasonal, chef-selected courses.
editorial.know_before: Doral hours are Sunday to Thursday 11:30am to 10:00pm and Friday to Saturday 11:30am to 10:30pm, with happy hour Monday to Sunday 3:00 to 6:30pm at this location.
editorial.local_tip: Try the 9-course OMAKAI Experience for premium seasonal ingredients and specialty cuts, or a Blue Crab or Maine Lobster hand roll from the official menu.

facts.claim: Right in the heart of Doral, the most recent OMAKAI sushi location delivers the full journey with curated nigiri and hand rolls, an intimate ambiance
